A BIG thank you to Huyen for her excellent and great service - service from the heart
Jan 2020 • Family
We are a group of 13 person whom have travelled to Hoi An and Da Nang from 22 jan to 27 jan. The stay here at Hoi An and Da Nang are a pleasant one. We stayed at Grand Mercure Hotel Da Nang for 3 days, from 24 jan to 27 jan and we are flying back to singapore today. During our stay here, I encountered a lovely young lady by the name of Huyen. I am so impressed by her excellent service and she really goes the extra miles to help with my enquiries during the breakfast sessions at LA RIVE GAUCHE on 25 Jan and 26 Jan. We always travel but I would like to rate her the top and best service hotel staff we have ever met. She is a great asset to the hotel. Every time when I approach her for help she will never fail to go the extra miles to help and she always wear a great smile on her face. This is the first time I send compliment to a hotel staff and it is not easy to get compliment from me really but if a person really deserve one, I will not hesitate.
Well done Huyen and I wish Huyen and Grand Mercure Hotel Success always. 
God bless all in Grand Mercure Hotel too .
